lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: The village below reads as a Commons holding in every register I can reach. That is unusual and I would like it to stay unusual.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: The village below is listed as a Meridian trust, inherited three times and never contested. I would not mention that to Sister Wren.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Dax has not spoken to me in two days. He is not being cruel; he is being consistent, which is worse.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: You have been generous to a thing that is owned. I notice. I am recording it in the register of the dead, which is the only register I have.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I keep the second office, the register of the dead, and now apparently a party inventory. I am content.
